geeklist.title: Many starting free auction! - Ends on the 18th
geeklist.description:
** Ends Friday, December 18th late in the evening (Pacific) with a possible extension to prevent sniping.
Shipping- ** Buyers will pay all shipping costs. ** I will use PirateShip ** I can combine shipping. ** Shipping within contiguous USA only. Shipping will happen ASAP but may take a bit longer depending on box requirements. ** Local pickup possible and preferred. Local [b]pickup[/b] may trump a higher bid at my discretion. ** Items will be shipped from 94306 (Palo Alto, CA), please be sure you're ok with the cost of shipping before you bid.
Bidding- ** All bids are in USD and in whole dollar increments. ** Items may have a starting bid price [SB] and/or a buy it now price [BIN] ** Once placed, a bid may not be edited without reaching out to me first
Payment- ** I accept Zelle or PayPal [b]F&F[/b] ** Payment due within 2 days of receiving full price with shipping
Misc- ** I reserve the right to withdraw a game from this list and to choose between valid bids for a game.
Users banned from my auctions: - MattInTheHat83 - TheDarkElf - Crixus_
If you have any questions, please feel free to message me. All games are in good condition or better unless otherwise stated.
This auction is listed in [geeklist=66420][/geeklist]
Will consider unbalanced trade offers, mostly for the items in the list below, as long as you cover shipping.
Items I might consider for trades: - Ethnos - Imperium: The Contention - Unmatched: Sling & Arrows, Volume One, Volume Three, Little Red Riding Hood vs Beowulf - Oath - Avalon: The Riven Veil - Magic Number Eleven - LotR LCG Saga Expansions - Agent Avenue - Black Rose Wars stuff - A War of Whispers - Tyrants of the Underdark (latest version) - Arcs - Leaders
%AUCTIONEND% DEC 18th %SHIPSFROM% SF Bay Area
%SHIPSTO% Anywhere in the US where I don't have to deal with any extra overhead
